executive_summary.strengths: Includes structure, closure mechanism, comparison table, multiple industry use cases, collapsible-vs-rigid FAQ, moisture limitation and contextual product links.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Article overpromises marketing effectiveness and transit protection, makes categorical closure-material assumptions, repeats branding/retention benefits, and contains visible punctuation errors. It lacks actionable procurement requirements.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Qualify market/ROI/protection assertions; explain magnet strength, box style, inserts, shipping validation, storage, sample approvals and costs; remove repeated branding rhetoric and proofread.
